# prime-tieredmenu

prime-rs: TieredMenu component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/tieredmenu) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-tieredmenu) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/tieredmenu.md)

TieredMenu — port of `p-tieredmenu` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A menu whose groups expand into nested panels next to the item. Items are `prime_menu::MenuItem`: the `items` field
defines the submenu. A group is expanded by click or the → arrow; after the first click expansion, hover works too (`auto_display`);
the keyboard moves across levels (↓ ↑ → ← `Home` `End` `Enter` `Space` `Escape` `Tab`, search by label prefix). In `popup` mode
the menu is shown at the target via `TieredMenuRef`. All transition logic lives in the pure model (the `model` module).

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_menu::MenuItem;
use prime_tieredmenu::TieredMenu;

let model = vec![MenuItem::new().label("File").items(vec![MenuItem::new().label("New")]), MenuItem::new().label("Quit")];
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <TieredMenu model=model /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-tieredmenu-root-list") && html.contains("aria-haspopup=\"menu\"") && html.contains("Quit"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-tieredmenu = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["tieredmenu"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
